observations: Industrial sewing machine with a white body and red accents.
Brand 'TWO LION' is printed on the upper right side of the machine head in photo 0.
The machine is mounted on a metal table with a roller table extension.
A motor is visible underneath the table, connected by a belt.
The machine is shown in a workshop or shop environment.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UWE NYONG' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The machine's size, table, and accessories (roller table, motor) are consistent with industrial use.
The seller's possession of the item is not verifiable from a photo.
The interior of the machine and the condition of the needle and bobbin area are not shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be noisy, weak, or have a burnt winding.
risks.proof: A video of the motor running at full speed.

risks.risk: The machine may have been repaired or modified, hiding the original condition.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the internal mechanism and the underside of the table.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Video of the motor running to check for noise and speed.
Photo of the underside of the table and the internal mechanism.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
